description: Lists AliExpress products with a real price drop, detected by our price history in the last 7 days (the seller's 'was' price does not count). Each product includes discount.certainty: 'verified' means the drop is proven by the time-weighted median of our readings and MAY be presented as savings; 'none' means there is no discount that can be claimed. The seller's 'was' price on the listing does not support any discount here. Quoting the percentage without the certainty next to it misinforms the reader.

apenas_verificados.description: Kept for compatibility: since 2026-10-14 this tool only returns products whose drop our price history proves.

busca.description: Text to look for in the title, only among the top drops read (up to 100); this is not a search of the whole catalog.

categoria.description: Category slug. Omit to search all categories.

desconto_minimo.description: Minimum real drop, in percent, against the typical price we measured.

idioma.description: Optional language for the human-readable text (title, discount.explanation, discount.warning, pageUrl): "en" (default), "de" or "pt". Field names, numbers and currency (USD) are the same in every language.

mercado.description: "us": only US listings, which ship within the United States only. "global": only listings that ship worldwide. Omit for both. For a shopper outside the US, use "global". Prices are always the ones read for the US.
